description: The claims waiting for the keeper's decision ? drafts, and accepted claims whose review went stale ? and the decisions. op=list returns items[] {id, title, state, stale, kind, tier, confidence, writer, date, subjects, language, sources, report, report_title}, oldest first, with filters report (an investigation id or its prefix), subject, kind (extraction | synthesis | interpretation | speculation), tier, confidence, writer, state (draft | stale), language, q (words in the title). op=accept puts claims into every answer from now on; op=dispute files why; op=retire keeps them on disk and out of every answer ? each takes ids[] (or id), or report for every waiting claim of one investigation (write access).

id.description: One claim id, instead of ids.

ids.description: For accept, dispute, retire: the claim ids.

kind.description: For list: the claim type ? extraction | synthesis | interpretation | speculation.

language.description: For list: the language of the claim's title.

patron.description: Optional: who is asking ? {did, name, runtime}. Anonymous when absent.

q.description: For list: words that must all appear in the title.

report.description: For list: only claims from this investigation; for a decision: every waiting claim of it.

tier.description: For list: the strongest source's tier.

writer.description: For list: who wrote the claim, matched as text (crew:explorer, person, ?).

name: library_inbox
